Regulations on Stipend Support Provision 
to the students of the autonomous organization of education 
“Nazarbayev University” 
 
(as amended as of October 15, 2019) 
 
1. General Provisions 
 
1. These Regulations on stipend support provision to the students of the 
autonomous organization of education “Nazarbayev University” (hereinafter referred to 
as Regulations) specify types of stipends awarded to the students of the autonomous 
organization of education “Nazarbayev University” (hereinafter referred to as University). 
They describe the proce dure for awarding and paying  stipends, and composition and 
authorities of the University Stipend Committee. 
Item 1 of Paragraph  2 has been amended in accordance with Decision of the Managing Council dated 
October 15, 2019 No.15.10.2019 
2. The following terms shall be used in these Regulations:  
1) students – students of  the Center for Preparatory Studies or  University 
Schools on:  
Nazarbayev University Foundation Year Program (NUFYP students);  
Bachelor programs (bachelor students);  
Master programs, including Doctor of Medicine Program (master students);  
Doctorate programs (doctoral students); 
Residency programs (residency students);   
2) stipend – monetary payment duly awarded and paid to students in order and 
amounts as established by these Regulations;  
3) Nazarbayev University Stipend – stipend awarded to student who is holder 
of Nazarbayev University educational grant; 
4) Stipend of the President of the RK – stipend established by the President of 
the Republic of Kazakhstan and awarded in accordance with legislation of the Republic 
of Kazakhstan; 
5) Stipend of the President of the University – stipend established by the 
University and awarded to bachelor and master students in accordance with section 5 of 
the Regulations; 
6) Kamkor Stipend – stipend established by the University and awarded to 
bachelor and master students in accordance with section 6 of the Regulations; 
7) Stipend Committee – a regular consultative body under the President of the 
University that executes functions in accordance with Regulations; 
8) Semester – Fall, Spring or Summer Semester defined in accordance with 
University study programs, and in case of Doctor of Medicine Program – academic year 
of study.

2. Stipend Support Provision to Students 
 
4. The purpose of stipend support provision to students is to stimulate research, 
teaching and learning  activities of conscientious students of the University , to provide 
social (financial) support  to students, as well as partial covering their expenses during 
their study.  
5. The following types of stipends are established at the University:  
1) the Nazarbayev University Stipend;  
2) the Stipend of the President of the RK;  
3) the Stipend of the President of the University; 
4) the Kamkor Stipend;  
5) name and other stipends.  
6. Each type of stipend is awarded and paid in accordance with procedures 
established by the Regulations. 
7. A stipend may be awarded  for 1 (one) semester unless otherwise is 
established by these Regulations. A stipend may be awarded to the same person more than 
once in accordance with procedures and conditions established by the Regulations. 
8. Students receiving one type of stipend have the right to receive another type 
of stipend provided that they meet the criteria established by the Regulations for each type 
of stipend.

except for the cases specified in clauses 28-30 of the Regulations. After returning from

established by the Regulations.

8. The University Stipend Committee 
 
46. The primary goal of the Stipend Committee is to consider the issues related 
to stipend support provision to students in accordance with the Regulations. 
47. In accordance with its primary goal , the Stipend Committee executes the 
following functions: 
1) determines and recommends amounts of the Stipend of the President of the 
University and the Kamkor Stipend within the University budget funds as well as their 
periods of awarding; 
2) considers the issues on awarding name  and other stipends and makes 
recommendations to the President of the University on establishing such stipends; 
3) considers the candidates for awarding the Stipend of the President of the RK, 
the Stipend of the President of the University and the Kamkor Stipend; 
4) upon consideration of candidates, recommends students for awarding the 
following stipends: 
            the Stipend of the President of the RK; 
            the Kamkor Stipend;  
 name and other stipends. 
48. Scheduled meetings of the  Stipend Committee shall be held not less than 
once every six months. Unscheduled meetings of the  Stipend Committee shall be 
convened as required. 
Paragraph 48-1 has been amended in accordance with Decision of the Managing Council dated July 25, 
2017 No.25.07.2017 
48-1. Meetings of the Stipend Support Committee can be carried out in absentia, 
including via interactive forms of communication. The Decision on carrying out the 
meeting in absentia shall be made by th e Chairperson or by the Deputy Chairperson in 
case of his absence. 
49. The meeting of the Stipend Committee is quorate if not less than half of all 
members are present at the meeting.
